Michio Kaku, author of popular sci/tech books like Physics of the Future, made some predictions as part of his keynote talk at the Infineon OktoberTech conference last week at the Computer History Museum.

Kaku, who was professor of theoretical physics at the City College of New York, covered a variety of predictions, including the future of supersonic jets, artificial intelligence and quantum computing during his keynote — and he showed off his stellar sense of humor.
